<thinking>mfga drops the anubandha vowel: the root is म्ग "to seek". Curadi
gives the stem m-stem: मेग-.  Lrn (perfect) forms the stem with ighta
suffix taking the root form मेग-, resulting in मेगि-. Uttama dvi kartari
takes the parasmaipada ending -आتماस्.</thinking>
<answer>मेगात्मास्</answer>

<thinking>mfga drops the anubandha vowel: the root is म्ग "to search". Curadi gives the stem मि-. Lrn (perfect) for kartari takes the ending -आमिः.  Therefore the form is मिआमः.</thinking>
<answer>मिआमः</answer>

<thinking>loqf~ drops the anubandha: the root is लृ "to slip". Bhvadi verbs take the a-stem.  For the AshirLin, we add the suffix -i- to the a-stem लृश्. The uttama dvi kartari ending is -amaḥ. Therefore, the final form is लृशिamaḥ.</thinking>
<answer>लृशिamaḥ</answer>

<thinking>loqf~ drops the anubandha vowel: the root is लौच् "to release". Bhvadi gives the i-stem लौचि-. AshirLin (optative) requires the stem to be लौच्+इया = लौचिया. Uttama dvi parasmaipada takes the ending -एताम्.</thinking>
<answer>लौचियाताम्</answer>
